description: This file defines the Exponential class which provides methods to compute the exponential distribution, including probability density function (pdf) and cumulative distribution function (cdf), as part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's statistical calculation functionality.

classes.name: Exponential
classes.description: A class providing methods to evaluate the exponential distribution, supporting both pdf and cdf calculations with input validation and array handling.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the exponential distribution's probability density function or cumulative distribution function based on input parameters. Handles array inputs and performs input validation.
